what: head-rebuild study: the RefCOCO-family candidate-restriction stage re-measured from our own mechanisms as deterministic re-analysis over cached records (SAM ViT-H pool + cached G2L masked-region features + cached VLM boxes; no vision re-generation)
attribution_note: Both drop-one directions, measured on the full official val splits (the reference arm reproduces the shipped released-score head bit-exactly, delta 0.0000): given the box, the released restriction is worth -1.45 / -0.56 / +0.29 mIoU; given the restriction, the box is worth +25.21 / +26.82 / +17.61 mIoU. Under the shipped iou box-fill and sentence box the restriction is ~neutral given the box; the quoted directive figures (box-over-full-pool 50.20/40.24/49.48) could not be reproduced under any tested configuration -- iou/cover/inside modes, sentence/noun phrase, LLaVA boxes (exp159b_boxsource_probe.json) -- and are recorded as unreconciled; the box carries the conjunction either way. Shape note (reviewer hypothesis, recorded): the quoted triple's ordering (highest refcoco, lowest refcocoplus, refcocog between) matches the released-scores-only arm (43.33/37.85/47.51), suggesting the quoted figure may have originated from a different arm/iteration or an older box cache rather than the shipped configuration. GroundingDINO boxes exist only on the gRefCOCO path and were not probed on this family; the measured deltas stand as recorded.

components.name: SAM ViT-H automatic mask generator (pps=8, released settings)
components.role: proposes the candidate pool for every dataset
components.evidence: exp/cache_map.py (settings replicated from the released commit)

components.name: HybridGL G2L masked-region feature extractor (modified CLIP ViT-B/16, masking_block=9)
components.role: per-proposal 512-d region features; read by the training-free reference realization and, as a feature path only (via our full-sentence text protocol), by the promoted head's region-text term -- declared platform

components.name: Full-sentence text embedding tower (released modified CLIP ViT-B/16 text encoder)
components.role: computes the full-sentence text embedding the promoted head's region-text term and the training-free reference realization score against; frozen, from third_party/modified_CLIP

components.name: Released semantic score sc = 0.5*text(sentence) + 0.5*text(noun phrase)
components.role: primary released scoring term of the training-free reference realization's restriction key; not used by the promoted head

components.name: Released GEM spatial-coherence score
components.role: second released scoring term in the training-free reference realization's restriction key; not used by the promoted head

components.name: Released fused top-3 selection (alpha=0.6 GEM mix)
components.role: the released pipeline's own pick; used by the training-free reference realization (and its box-missing no-box fallback); not used by the promoted head, whose box-missing records take the head's own prediction

components.name: Released-score top-15 candidate restriction (rank01(sc)+0.4906*rank01(gem))
components.role: narrows the pool before the box pick in the training-free reference realization; replaced by the learned head in the shipped realization

components.name: Dense localization prior: LLaVA-OneVision-7B (local checkpoint) queried with the full expression
components.role: frozen VLM box for the referent (the component this run proposed)

components.name: Box-fill selection rule (loc = |mask n box| / |mask u box|, argmax within candidate set)
components.role: picks the instance within the candidate set

components.name: gRefCOCO multi-term machinery (clause decomposition, per-term box+SAM picks, union)
gRefCOCO no-target decision (three-prompt existence ensemble + abstention)
gRefCOCO learned acceptance prior (HistGradientBoosting, declared trained)
components.role: transfer-aware acceptance for the shipped gRefCOCO row (rank features + stratified weights + two-target tau)

components.name: Open-vocabulary detector gate (GroundingDINO) on the gRefCOCO path
components.role: second box source for term-level picks on gRefCOCO

components.name: Evaluation protocol alignment (official gRefCOCO evaluation; pooled global oIoU for the RefCOCO family)
components.role: keeps every shipped number under the compared papers' protocol

arms.name: reference: released-score top-15 restriction + box-fill pick (shipped head)
arms.role: the shipped RefCOCO-family head, reproduced bit-for-bit as deterministic re-analysis: candidate set = top-15 by rank01(sc) + 0.4906*rank01(gem) (released semantic + GEM), pick = argmax box-fill within

arms.name: attribution: released-scores-only top-1 (no box, no restriction effect)
arms.role: drop-the-box control: global argmax of the released fused key

arms.name: attribution: box-fill pick over the FULL pool (no text restriction)
arms.role: drop-the-restriction control: argmax box-fill over all SAM proposals

arms.name: ours: region-text top-15 restriction (fg @ full-sentence CLIP) + box-fill pick
arms.role: restriction rebuilt from our own protocol: top-15 by the cached masked-region feature against the FULL-sentence CLIP embedding (no released text ensemble, no GEM term), same box-fill pick

arms.name: attribution: our region-text key alone, top-1 (no box)
arms.role: drop-the-box control for the ours-only restriction stage

arms.name: ours: geometric guards only (center-in-box, mask/box area <= 4) + box-fill pick
arms.role: no text at all: guard-filter by mask centroid inside the box and mask-to-box area ratio <= 4, then argmax box-fill

arms.name: ours: strict geometric guards (center-in-box, mask/box area in [0.1, 2]) + box-fill pick
arms.role: no text at all: guard-filter by mask centroid inside the box and mask-to-box area ratio in [0.1, 2], then argmax box-fill

arms.name: attribution: box-fill pick (cover mode) over the FULL pool
arms.role: overlap-mode variant of the drop-the-restriction control (mask-covers-box fraction)

arms.name: attribution: box-fill pick (inside mode) over the FULL pool
arms.role: overlap-mode variant of the drop-the-restriction control (mask-inside-box fraction)

arms.name: ours: learned head over geometric terms only, richer set (no text, no features)
arms.role: HistGradientBoosting over box overlap (iou + cover), center-in-box, area ratio, mask area, centroid-to-box-center distance, box area, within-record rank, containment-parent; fitted on the held-out TRAIN tune refs only; uses neither released scores nor text

arms.name: ours: learned head over geometric terms only (no text, no features)
arms.role: HistGradientBoosting over box overlap, center-in-box, area ratio, mask area, within-record rank, containment-parent; fitted on the held-out TRAIN tune refs only; uses neither released scores nor text nor the masked-region features

arms.name: ours: learned head over our own per-proposal terms (HistGradientBoosting, declared trained)
arms.role: small head fitted on the RefCOCO-family held-out TRAIN tune refs only (1,137/1,120/765 records; target = proposal IoU >= 0.5); features are all ours: full-sentence region-text score, box overlap, center-in-box, area ratio, mask area, within-row ranks, containment-parent flag; val is a single frozen application

feature_path_marginal.definition: marginal value of the feature-derived region-text term within the promoted head = learned_head mIoU minus learned_geom2 mIoU (the best feature-free learned arm), full official val splits
feature_path_marginal.seed_note: single seed (random_state 0) for all fitted heads; a multi-seed std is not yet measured (disclosed, non-blocking)

verdict: PROMOTE: the ours-only arm 'learned_head' holds parity or better with the released-score head on all three full official val splits (mean 67.47 vs reference 66.11; deltas refcoco +2.03, refcocoplus +1.68, refcocog +0.39), so the candidate-restriction stage no longer depends on the released scores -- ours-only scoring on a declared released-feature platform -- and the promotion rests on that platform declaration: no feature-free arm held parity (the best, learned_geom2, falls 0.54 below the reference on refcocog), so the dependency is quantified, not removed. Wording held precise: all scoring rules and learned weights are ours and no released score enters the promoted head on any record (box-missing records take the head's own prediction). One input representation is computed by the released G2L extractor (declared platform): within the promoted head the region-text term's marginal value over the best feature-free learned arm is +0.60 / +0.81 / +0.93 mIoU, and without it the best feature-free arm falls 0.54 mIoU short of the reference on refcocog.
